purpose: Define the minimum product architecture for a durable Agent owner or the Universal SYSTEM_INFRA control plane without requiring one specific agent framework.

compatibility.rule: A shared contract upgrade may remain backward compatible with explicitly listed prior manifest versions. Unknown future versions fail closed. Owner-local vocabulary or field shapes must map through central compatibility rules rather than silently redefining shared semantics.
compatibility.manifest_1_2_admission_note: Manifest 1.2 is admitted only through explicit shared-semantic mappings already used by compatible 1.1 owners. Compatibility admission proves structural interpretability only; it does not prove live quality, current-session execution, provider isolation, or independent attestation.

skill.principle: Skill should route, progressively load references and retain only compact hard boundaries that must always be visible. Executable business logic and detailed domain policy belong in runtime/workflow/guards/references rather than duplicated prose. The byte target applies only to the always-loaded Skill router file; it is not a cap on the repository, research corpus, distilled knowledge, examples, projects, evidence, stock data or novel canon.

runtime.principle: A Skill, prompt, configured role or code stub alone is not an executable Agent runtime. Owner-local assurance detail may refine a shared execution class but cannot invent a new shared class without a central contract mapping.

workflow.principle: Durable stage/state truth and transition guards must live outside chat prose.

harness.principle: Owner Harness evaluates domain contract/trajectory/quality. Universal evaluates the shared Agent architecture contract so owners do not copy the same architecture checker into every repository.

references.principle: Large domain knowledge is progressively loaded from canonical references, not copied into the hot-path Skill. Distribution/compatibility mirror details may be owner-local, but their shared class is centrally normalized.

continuity.principle: Recovery and capability metadata are durable pointers; they do not replace business runtime state, and SYSTEM_INFRA must not invent business-only adapter fields.

knowledge_scaling.principle: Scale knowledge by progressive disclosure and indexed owner-local corpora, not by expanding the always-loaded Skill router.
knowledge_scaling.loading_rule: Load metadata/index first, then only the exact references/data/artifacts required by the current stage/action. Large knowledge bases must remain searchable/indexed and source-bounded; they must not be copied wholesale into the Skill or startup bootstrap.
knowledge_scaling.quality_rule: A larger corpus is not itself architecture drift. Drift exists when detailed knowledge/policy is duplicated into the always-loaded router, when authority is ambiguous, or when retrieval/indexing cannot identify the current canonical source.

context_footprint.principle: Claims that a router/bootstrap/tool exposure is thin or more efficient require measured context footprint evidence rather than line-count or prose claims alone.
context_footprint.owner_rule: Existing Skill target_max_bytes remains the shared owner hot-path router target. It is explicitly not a repository/corpus limit. Broader owner context/tool-surface comparisons are measured when an owner claims an efficiency improvement or when drift indicates hot-path context growth; no owner must preload a new global context bundle merely to satisfy measurement.

architecture_relevant_surfaces: reference authority topology and canonical policy declarations
freshness.business_artifact_only_change_rule: A newer whole-repository HEAD does not by itself stale architecture validation when a current remote observation compares from the validated head to the observed head and proves that the delta contains no architecture-relevant surface change. Ordinary business artifacts, article workspaces, generated outputs, task checkpoints, research receipts and project content do not invalidate architecture architecture solely because they moved the repository HEAD.
freshness.fail_closed_rule: If the HEAD differs and no complete current delta classification exists, if the delta evidence does not bind exactly from architecture_validation_head to observed_owner_head, or if any architecture-relevant surface changed, architecture validation is stale and must be revalidated.
freshness.rule: Prefer architecture-relevant delta identity over whole-repository HEAD equality. Exact HEAD equality remains a safe fallback. This prevents legitimate owner business-state commits from creating recurrent false-positive architecture drift while still failing closed on architecture/control changes.

admission.tracer_bullet_definition: Prove one narrow end-to-end path through the real discovery/routing/runtime/state/evidence boundary before expanding the integration. Use the smallest path that can falsify the architecture, then grow coverage from observed evidence.
